body:
Data will only appear in the URL if the custom widget has the following two life cycles too:

- `getWidgetState(uiState, { helper, searchParameters }): UIState` (merged with existing UIState)
- `getWidgetSearchParameters(searchParameters, { uiState }): SearchParameters` (merged with existing search parameters, usually using helper methods)

> https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/widgets/create-your-own-widgets/js/?language=js#the-widget-lifecycle-and-api
